title: Writes waiting to be applied
hook: A toy replica receives writes faster than it applies them. Can it clear the pending stock?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Calculate pending unapplied writes while separating receipt from application.

misconception: Receiving a write means every replica has already applied it.
objective: Calculate pending unapplied writes while separating receipt from application.

claims.text: Original stipulated feedback model: A inputs [6, 4, 3, 4] yield 10; B inputs [6, 4, 6, 4] yield 0. Prediction correct option 0. A ends with {A} pending writes; B with {B}. Six applications against four new writes drain the initial six-write backlog, then the zero floor stops depletion. A fixed backlog model; read visibility, ordering, consistency and replication delay in time are not represented.

claims.text: A toy replica starts with 9 pending writes, receives 2 and applies 5 each round for four rounds. Pending at end? Net drain is three writes per round until empty; the stock cannot become negative.
